speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe the concerning rash you are experiencing, including where it is located on your body and how it looks. Additionally, tell me about any recent health changes you have noticed.

speaker: Patient
text: 47-year-old male. The patient presents with a rash that started last night, finding it very concerning. He does not recall being exposed to any new environmental stimuli such as detergents or plants like poison ivy. He mentions he recently started seeing a primary care provider for arthritis management and a new onset cough.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug Reaction with Eosinophilia and Systemic Symptoms (DRESS) syndrome, likely triggered by a new medication for arthritis management. The combination of a new rash, recent onset cough, and initiation of a new drug for arthritis is highly suspicious for this condition. I will need to confirm this with a blood panel showing eosinophilia and liver enzymes, and I will request images of the rash to assess its distribution.
